findings.description: Removing the custom __reduce_ex__ means pickling a Sentinel falls back to Enum's default reduction, which rebuilds the member from its value (a fresh object()), so the unpickled value is not the UNSET singleton.
findings.rationale: Trigger: pickling a structure that holds click.utils.UNSET (for example a Parameter or default value) and loading it back. Under the old code, __reduce_ex__ returned getattr(Sentinel, name), preserving identity. With the default Enum reduction, the value object() is serialized as a new object and Sentinel(value) lookup fails or yields a non-identical member, so identity checks like `value is UNSET` break. Impact: unpickled objects silently treat UNSET as a real value or raise on load.
